title: Tensile strength of two alloys
intro: A materials lab compares the tensile strength (MPa) of two aluminium alloys: 10 coupons of alloy A and 8 of alloy B, tested on the same machine. Is there a difference in mean strength? H₀: μ_A − μ_B = 0 against H₁: μ_A − μ_B ≠ 0 at α = 0.05. The samples are independent (different coupons), the sizes differ and alloy B looks more spread out, so the test is Welch's t-test. Read the statistic, its degrees of freedom, the p-value and the confidence interval for μ_A − μ_B.
